AI Presales Engineer l Riyadh or Jeddah, KSA

We are working with a leading global technology and digital infrastructure organisation that is expanding its enterprise AI capabilities across the region.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a business at the forefront of global connectivity, cloud, digital transformation and enterprise technology, helping organisations transform the way they operate through intelligent, AI-powered solutions.

As an AI Presales Engineer, you will play a key role in bringing these solutions to life - working directly with enterprise customers, understanding their business challenges and designing innovative AI architectures that deliver measurable value.

You'll combine hands-on technical expertise with customer engagement, solution design and commercial presales, taking AI opportunities from initial discovery through to demonstrations, proof of concepts and technical proposals.

The Role:

• Engage with enterprise customers to understand business challenges and identify opportunities for AI adoption.
• Lead technical discovery sessions and translate business requirements into AI solutions.
• Design enterprise AI architectures using LLMs, Generative AI, RAG and agentic workflows.
• Develop and deliver technical demonstrations, prototypes and proof of concepts.
• Work alongside sales and account management teams to develop customer opportunities.
• Lead technical responses to RFPs and RFQs, including solution proposals, BOQs, BOMs and project estimates.
• Present solution architectures and recommendations to technical and senior business stakeholders.
• Advise customers on AI integration, scalability, security, data privacy and cloud infrastructure.

Technical Experience & Qualifications:

• 5+ years experience in AI Presales, Solutions Engineering, Solution Architecture or a similar customer-facing technical role.
• Strong practical experience with Python, LLMs, Generative AI and Machine Learning.
• Hands-on experience designing and architecting enterprise AI solutions using RAG, AI agents and workflow orchestration.
• Experience with at least one AI orchestration platform, such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Google Vertex AI Agent Builder or Amazon Bedrock Agents.
• Proven experience delivering technical demonstrations, prototypes and Proofs of Concept (PoCs).
• Experience managing customer-facing presales activities, including technical discovery, solution design, RFPs/RFQs, BOQs/BOMs and technical proposals.
• Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Data Science or a related discipline.

Why Consider This Opportunity

• Join a major global technology organisation with an established enterprise customer base.
• Work at the forefront of Generative AI, LLMs and emerging agentic AI technologies.
• Engage with enterprise customers and help shape their AI transformation strategies.
• Combine technical architecture, innovation and commercial exposure.
• Play an important role in developing and delivering next-generation AI solutions across the region.

Location: Riyadh or Jeddah, KSA

As a subsidiary of the global Bupa Group, we draw upon international expertise while maintaining a profound understanding of local healthcare requirements and regulations. This allows us to offer comprehensive healthcare insurance solutions tailored to the unique needs of the Saudi Arabian market.
